description: This file `ChatImageUtils.tsx` contains utility functions and types related to handling chat messages with multimedia content, such as converting images to base64, creating chat messages with images, and displaying chat content with attachments.

methods.name: convertImageToBase64
methods.description: Converts a File object (image) into a base64-encoded data URI string asynchronously.

methods.name: createChatMultimodalMessage
methods.description: Creates a chat message object with text and an image URL, converting the image to base64 asynchronously.

methods.name: createChatDisplayMessage
methods.description: Generates a display message object for the chat, including text and optional file attachment indication and preview URL.

methods.name: shouldShowChatAttachedImage
methods.description: Determines whether to display an attached image in a chat message based on its content and properties.
